doc-3e362bd24b5001b94c2e2cdbeeac4ffa.content: The Semantic SEO framework consists of several core concepts. Source Context defines how content is connected to the entity. Topical Maps organize content into query networks. Information Responsiveness measures how well answers match query intent. Query-on-Trial evaluates queries against content quality. Micro-semantics handles fine-grained meaning in search.
